title: The product comparison maps
statement:
Use the field and coefficient datum, the geometric six-functor datum,
and the bounded constructible finite-Tor categories of [def-sf-kv-maps]:
$p$ and $\ell$ are distinct primes, $a\geq1$ is an integer,
$k=\overline{\mathbf F}_{p^a}$,
$E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer
$\varpi_E$, an integer $n\geq1$, and
$\Lambda\in\{\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n,\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$.
Integral pullbacks and tensors are completed; field coefficients use the
specified localization and common finite stages. All products below are
over $k$, and $C_1\boxtimes C_2=Lr_1^*C_1\otimes^L_\Lambda Lr_2^*C_2$
for the product projections $r_i$. The four maps below are precisely the
maps of [def-sf-kv-maps], formed with its geometric adjunctions,
base-change transformations, signed tensor constraints and internal Hom.

For $i=1,2$ let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be separated of finite type between
separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with $Rf_i^!$ the constructible exceptional adjoints
of [sk-def-sf-operations](vi) (no ambient exceptional-adjoint datum is assumed), put $f=f_1\times f_2$, and let
$L_i\in\Dctf(Y_i,\Lambda)$, $B_i\in\Dctf(X_i,\Lambda)$.

1. **(i)** The $!$-Künneth
$\mathrm{Ku}_!:Rf_!(B_1\boxtimes B_2)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ } Rf_{1!}B_1\boxtimes Rf_{2!}B_2$ is constructed as in [def-sf-kv-maps](i):
put $T=Y_1\times_kY_2$, $U=X_1\times_kY_2$,
$V=Y_1\times_kX_2$, $u=f_1\times\operatorname{id}_{Y_2}$,
$v=\operatorname{id}_{Y_1}\times f_2$, and let $t_i:T\to Y_i$,
$a_1:U\to X_1$, $a_2:V\to X_2$ be the projections.
Identify $W=U\times_TV$ with $X_1\times_kX_2$, with projections
$p:W\to U$, $q:W\to V$ and $up=vq=f$.
Apply [sk-thm-sf-kunneth-relative] over $T$ to
$K=La_1^*B_1$, $H=La_2^*B_2$. Its source is identified with
$Rf_!(B_1\boxtimes B_2)$ and its target is
$Ru_!K\otimes^L Rv_!H$.
The two Cartesian squares give the compact-support exchanges of
[sk-def-sf-exchanges], invertible on these domains as specified in
[def-sf-kv-maps](i):
$$
\operatorname{Ex}_{!,1}:Lt_1^*Rf_{1!}B_1\xrightarrow{\sim}Ru_!K,
\qquad
\operatorname{Ex}_{!,2}:Lt_2^*Rf_{2!}B_2\xrightarrow{\sim}Rv_!H.
$$
Postcompose the relative map with
$\operatorname{Ex}_{!,1}^{-1}\otimes^L\operatorname{Ex}_{!,2}^{-1}$
to obtain the displayed target. Every arrow is an isomorphism.
1. **(ii)** The *exceptional Künneth*
$\alpha:Rf_1^!L_1\boxtimes Rf_2^!L_2\to Rf^!(L_1\boxtimes L_2)$ is the
exceptional adjoint of
$$
Rf_!\bigl(Rf_1^!L_1\boxtimes Rf_2^!L_2\bigr)
\xrightarrow{\ \mathrm{Ku}_!\ }
Rf_{1!}Rf_1^!L_1\boxtimes Rf_{2!}Rf_2^!L_2
\xrightarrow{\ \varepsilon_1\boxtimes\varepsilon_2\ }
L_1\boxtimes L_2 ,
$$
where the $\varepsilon_i$ are the counits of $Rf_{i!}\dashv Rf_i^!$.
1. **(iii)** For $E_i\in\Dctf(Y_i,\Lambda)$, on the same scheme $Y_i$ as
$L_i$, the *external Hom* map
$$
\beta:\RHom(E_1,L_1)\boxtimes\RHom(E_2,L_2)
\longrightarrow\RHom\bigl(E_1\boxtimes E_2,L_1\boxtimes L_2\bigr)
$$
is the tensor–Hom transpose of the two evaluations, with the tensor symmetry
and its Koszul signs. Explicitly, write $H_i=\RHom(E_i,L_i)$ and let
$t_i:Y_1\times_kY_2\to Y_i$ be the projections. Reassociate and permute
$(H_1\boxtimes H_2)\otimes^L(E_1\boxtimes E_2)$ to
$Lt_1^*(H_1\otimes^LE_1)\otimes^L Lt_2^*(H_2\otimes^LE_2)$,
apply $Lt_1^*\operatorname{ev}_1\otimes^LLt_2^*\operatorname{ev}_2$,
and transpose, exactly as in [def-sf-kv-maps](iii).
1. **(iv)** For separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$, with the structure
morphism $a_Y$ and the product projection
$p_X=\operatorname{id}_X\times a_Y:X\times Y\to X$ (whose constructible
exceptional adjoints $Ra_Y^!$, $Rp_X^!$ are the inputs for
$\omega_Y=Ra_Y^!\Lambda$ and $\mathbb D_Y$, for $Rp_X^!$, and for
$\alpha_{\operatorname{id}_X,a_Y}$; no ambient exceptional-adjoint datum is assumed),
and for $M\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ and $N\in\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$, with
$p_X,p_Y$ the projections of $X\times Y$, the *Künneth–Verdier* map is
$$
\begin{aligned}
\kappa_{M,N}:M\boxtimes\mathbb D_YN
&\xrightarrow{\ \beta\ }\RHom\bigl(p_Y^*N,M\boxtimes\omega_Y\bigr)\\
&\xrightarrow{\ \RHom(1,\alpha_{\operatorname{id}_X,a_Y})\ }
\RHom\bigl(p_Y^*N,Rp_X^!M\bigr),
\end{aligned}
$$
where $\mathbb D_YN=\RHom(N,\omega_Y)$, and $p_Y^*$ denotes $Lp_Y^*$.
The second arrow uses (ii) with $f_1=\operatorname{id}_X$, $f_2=a_Y$,
$L_1=M$ and $L_2=\Lambda_{\operatorname{Spec}k}$, identifying
$X\times_k\operatorname{Spec}k$ with $X$, exactly as in [def-sf-kv-maps](iv).
Use the unit identifications $\RHom(\Lambda_X,M)=M$ and
$\Lambda_X\boxtimes N=p_Y^*N$; here $\beta$ is applied to the pairs
$(E_1,L_1)=(\Lambda_X,M)$ on $X$ and $(E_2,L_2)=(N,\omega_Y)$ on $Y$.

Only $\mathrm{Ku}_!$ is built from isomorphisms; invertibility of
$\alpha,\beta,\kappa$ is the content of [sk-thm-sf-kunneth-verdier].

split_report.summary: Split this definition by reusing the already reviewed expanded definition def-sf-kv-maps in the same unit. Made the field/coefficient/operation datum explicit, retained the four canonical maps, expanded the two inverse compact-support exchanges in (i), the signed evaluation transpose in (iii), and the inputs and derived pullback in (iv). No new nodes. Corrected the separated-target scope already disputed in the expanded definition; no ambient adjoint datum is assumed. The Lean HasKunnethComparisons structure is not an attachment: it records Nonempty isomorphisms instead of these specified maps.

unit_statement_error.failure: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: finite-type targets need not be separated, but the stipulated relative-product construction invokes sk-thm-sf-kunneth-relative with separated base T=Y_1 x_k Y_2. Take Y_1 the affine line with doubled origin, Y_2=Spec k and both f_i identities. The imported hypotheses hold while T is not separated. This is a failing inference, not a counterexample to the underlying product theorem.
unit_statement_error.correction: Require separated finite-type schemes, as in the reviewed expanded def-sf-kv-maps, its geometric operations datum and the intended applications. Keep all four maps and the relative-product route. Protected unit.statement remains unchanged.
